svg.title: TabFM - classifier
svg.desc: Google - column and row stages run twice, then an in-context stack · 1.64 B parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); SwiGLU: gated linear unit with a Swish activation; RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input. How to read: each table: training rows above, test rows below, columns across; attention across rows, within a column; the arrow points from the test rows to the training rows they read; attention across columns or features, within a row; inducing points: a small learned set that summarises the rows; outlined cells: an embedding, where every cell becomes a vector; the prediction for the test rows; one wide column: after this point the table's columns are merged into one vector per row; × N: the block is stacked N times; over rows / columns / features: the axis this block's attention runs across; right columns: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count.

numeric matrix; NaN is mapped to the sentinel -100
